method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation including amendments to the Industrial Relations Legislation Amendment Act 2021 Pt 6 (No. 30 of 2021, in force 12 February 2022), as deposited at registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_44571.txt (retrieved 7 September 2026); no regulations; the Sovereign's birthday (proclaimed yearly in the Gazette) and proclamations under ss 7 and 8 taken as inputs; Easter computed by the Gregorian reckoning (encoder's choice)

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the employee in WA: on what day each Second Schedule holiday falls in a given year, including Labour Day, Western Australia Day, Easter and the weekend extra days for New Year's Day, Australia Day (moved), Anzac Day, Christmas Day and Boxing Day; the year's list and count of public holidays; which holidays fall on a day; whether a day is a public holiday for me given proclamations under s 7 (special days) and s 8 (substituted days); bank holidays including Saturdays (ss 5, 6) and bank closing (s 10); and whether a WA industrial instrument or the Act prevails, including the Easter Sunday rules and s 9 (ss 3, 9). Half-holidays, district limits, Gazette notice periods and machinery out; pay and work on public holidays belong to the Fair Work Act 2009 ss 114-116.
lives: chloe c042 (2024-05-06): three months served -- which days are public holidays in WA (Labour Day 4 March, Western Australia Day 3 June, and the rest of 2024's eleven days)
